title: Aspect Deep 2: Frequency Adverbs and Habitual Patterns
description: Beyond часто and всегда. The B1 frequency family adds редко, никогда, постоянно, регулярно, and habitual time patterns like по утрам and по выходным.
descriptionRussian: За пределами 'часто' и 'всегда'. На уровне B1 добавляются 'редко', 'никогда', 'постоянно', 'регулярно' и регулярные временные конструкции 'по утрам', 'по выходным'.
intro: More cue words, and they work the way the A2 ones did. What is new is a whole construction rather than a single adverb: putting a time word in the plural after по builds a habitual frame around the sentence, and that frame locks the aspect regardless of what else is going on. You met that construction in the A2 time book. Here it is doing grammatical work.
rules: B1 frequency adverbs (редко, постоянно, регулярно, никогда не) extend the A2 family and trigger the imperfective for the same reason: they signal repeated or habitual action.
The 'по + dative plural' construction (по утрам, по вечерам, по выходным, по понедельникам) creates a habitual frame and locks the verb into the imperfective.
Frequency cues describe HOW OFTEN. They do not describe a single completed event. The perfective describes a single completed event and is therefore incompatible with the habitual reading.
examples: Маша редко пила кофе по утрам. (Masha rarely drank coffee in the mornings.) Редко + по утрам: two stacked frequency cues, both → НСВ.
Антон постоянно звонил нам. (Anton constantly called us.) Постоянно → НСВ.
Лена регулярно писала статьи. (Lena regularly wrote articles.) Регулярно → НСВ.
Я по выходным смотрел старые фильмы. (On weekends I (m) watched old films.) По выходным → НСВ.
Каждый раз, когда она приходила, она рассказывала нам новости. (Every time she came, she would tell us the news.) Habitual subordinate clause → НСВ in both verbs.
Они никогда не делали уроки вместе. (They never did the homework together.) Никогда не → НСВ (recap from Lesson 1).

rows.label: Zero (negation)
cells: Я никогда не пил это вино.

rows.label: По + dative plural
cells: по утрам, по вечерам, по выходным, по понедельникам

items.promptEnglish: I (m) have never watched this film.
items.hint: Recap from Lesson 1: which aspect pairs with никогда in negation?
items.explanation: Recap from Lesson 1: никогда (never) under не combines with the imperfective for the 'no engagement, ever' reading. Past masc -л: смотрел. Today's lesson extends this to the broader frequency family.

items.promptEnglish: Masha rarely drank coffee in the mornings.
items.hint: Two frequency cues stacked: редко and по утрам. Aspect?
items.explanation: Both редко (rarely) and по утрам (in the mornings) are frequency cues, and stacking them only strengthens the habitual reading. The imperfective пила, fem -ла.

items.prompt: Антон постоянно _____ нам и спрашивал о здоровье.
items.promptEnglish: Anton constantly called us and asked about our health.
items.hint: Постоянно signals what kind of occurrence?
items.explanation: Постоянно (constantly, all the time) is a frequency cue: the calls were repeated. Imperfective звонил, masc -л. Note: the second verb 'спрашивал' is also imperfective, agreeing with the habitual frame.

items.promptEnglish: Lena regularly wrote articles for the magazine.
items.hint: Регулярно is a B1-level frequency cue. Past fem.
items.explanation: Регулярно (regularly) signals repeated action and locks in the imperfective. Past fem -ла: писала.

items.prompt: По выходным мы _____ старые фильмы у бабушки.
items.promptEnglish: On weekends we watched old films at Grandma's.
items.hint: По выходным is a habitual time pattern. Plural subject.
items.explanation: По выходным (on weekends, every weekend) is a 'по + dative plural' habitual pattern: the watching repeated each weekend. Imperfective смотрели, plural -ли.

items.prompt: Каждый раз, когда она приходила, она _____ нам новости.
items.promptEnglish: Every time she came, she would tell us the news.
items.hint: 'Каждый раз, когда' frames the whole clause as habitual. Past fem.
items.explanation: 'Каждый раз, когда...' is a habitual subordinate clause: the action repeated each time the condition was met. Both verbs in the sentence are imperfective. Past fem -ла: рассказывала.

blanks: Я редко _____ дома: всегда был на работе. (I (m) rarely cooked at home; I was always at work.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Two frequency cues: редко (rarely) and всегда (always; modifying 'был на работе'). Both signal habit. Imperfective готовил, masc -л.

errorCorrection.sentence: Раньше по понедельникам Лена купила продукты на всю неделю.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: In the past, Lena would buy groceries for the whole week on Mondays.
errorCorrection.explanation: 'По понедельникам' (every Monday) is a 'по + dative plural' habitual pattern, and 'раньше' anchors it as a past routine, so the imperfective покупала is required. The perfective купила names one completed shopping trip, which cannot pair with an every-Monday frame. Habitual frequency always selects the imperfective, because repeated instances cannot live inside a single-completion form.

errorCorrection.sentence: Той зимой Антон постоянно опоздал на работу.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: That winter, Anton was constantly late for work.
errorCorrection.explanation: 'Постоянно' (constantly, all the time) is a high-frequency cue: the lateness recurred, so the imperfective опаздывал. The perfective опоздал names a single completed instance of being late, which contradicts 'постоянно'. Any cue meaning 'over and over' forces the imperfective, since one bounded event cannot repeat inside the same frame.

errorCorrection.sentence: Тем летом Соня каждое утро покормила кошку соседей.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: That summer, Sonya fed the neighbours' cat every morning.
errorCorrection.explanation: 'Каждое утро' (every morning) signals a repeated action, and 'тем летом' frames it in the past, so the imperfective кормила is correct. The perfective покормила names one completed feeding, which the every-morning frame contradicts. Maximal-frequency cues with каждый behave exactly like часто and постоянно: they demand the imperfective.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Masha often drank coffee in the mornings.
minimalPairs.explanation: Часто and по утрам are both frequency cues: stacked habit. Imperfective пила, fem -ла. The perfective выпила marks a single completed drink and is incompatible with the habitual reading.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Lena constantly read books on the metro.
minimalPairs.explanation: Постоянно (constantly) is a frequency cue. Imperfective читала, fem -ла. The perfective прочитала would mark a single book finished, which 'constantly read books' contradicts.

reviewVocab.definition: regularly (B1 frequency cue; signals repeated action and triggers the imperfective)
reviewVocab.example: Лена регулярно писала статьи для журнала.

reviewVocab.definition: rarely (frequency cue at the low end of the frequency scale; pairs with the imperfective like all frequency cues)
reviewVocab.example: Маша редко пила кофе по утрам.

reviewVocab.definition: on weekends, every weekend (по + dative plural construction; creates a habitual time pattern that triggers the imperfective)
reviewVocab.example: По выходным мы гуляли в парке.
